patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: (his wife) He's got myeloma. All this last week he's been muddled — drinking gallons, up all night to the toilet, and he hasn't opened his bowels in five days. He's just not with us.
clinical.presentationShort: 66yo M, myeloma — 1 week of confusion, polyuria, polydipsia, constipation and profound fatigue. Dry and drowsy.
clinical.presentationLong: 66-year-old male with myeloma, one week of confusion, excessive thirst and urination, constipation and profound fatigue; he is dry and drowsy.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → calcium and renal profile, aggressive IV saline rehydration, bisphosphonate, ECG
diagnosis.why: Stones, bones, groans and psychiatric moans. Send a calcium on every confused cancer patient — hypercalcaemia is common, very treatable and lethal when missed. Fluids first, bisphosphonate second. Note that all six vitals are green: the whole case is in the story.
diagnosis.redFlag: Confusion with polyuria and constipation in a myeloma patient — hypercalcaemia, which will stop the heart if it is missed.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a black 66-year-old man in a loose jumper, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting slumped back with arms heavy in his lap, head tilted slightly
aiImageGeneration.expression: drowsy, vacant and slow, not quite present
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: quietly and seriously unwell despite unremarkable observations
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a black 66-year-old man in a loose jumper, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting slumped back with arms heavy in his lap, head tilted slightly. Expression: drowsy, vacant and slow, not quite present. Clearly visible: dry cracked lips; heavy drooping eyelids; a slack vacant expression. Overall: quietly and seriously unwell despite unremarkable observations. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
